meta_description: Free web app by UCT Prague & Charles University to visualize and convert molecules from PubChem, PDB, COD, SDF, and CIF into multicolor 3D-printable 3MF and STL models.
meta_keywords: 3D print molecules, molecular 3D printing, PubChem to STL, PDB to 3MF, CIF to STL, multicolor molecule model, chemistry teaching models, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio
meta_author: UCT Prague, First Faculty of Medicine – Charles University
og_title: 3D Printing Molecules – Free 3MF & STL Molecule Generator
og_description: Convert molecular structures from PubChem, PDB, COD, SDF, and CIF into multicolor 3MF and STL files ready for 3D printing.
seo_home_h1: 3D Printing Molecules – Free Online PubChem, PDB & CIF to 3MF/STL Generator
seo_overview_title: Prepare Molecular Structures for Multicolor 3D Printing
seo_overview_lead: Developed by UCT Prague and Charles University, this browser-based tool converts chemical and biological structures into watertight 3D-printable models in seconds for classrooms, labs, and makers.
seo_feature_databases_desc: Fetch compounds by name, CID, or CAS number from PubChem, macromolecular entries from RCSB PDB, or crystal structures from COD—or drop your own .sdf, .pdb, and .cif files.
seo_feature_styles_desc: Generate space-filling CPK Spheres, Split Spheres for Gluing on single-extruder printers, Ball-and-Stick, Print-in-Place Moving Joints, Sticks, or voxel Minecraft models.
seo_feature_export_desc: Export multi-object .3MF files with pre-assigned CPK atom colors or a ZIP of separate .STL meshes, or launch directly in PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, and Ultimaker Cura.
seo_link_about: Learn more about the academic project
seo_toggle_label: Application overview and frequently asked questions
invalid_file_type: Invalid file type. Use .sdf, .mol, .pdb, .cif or ChemDraw (.cdx, .cdxml)
prusaslicer_plugin_lite_hint: A lite version of this web app
prusaslicer_plugin_desc: You can also insert molecules directly in PrusaSlicer with our plugin. It is a lite version of this web app – it covers the basics, while the full set of options is available here on the web.
share_button_title: Copy link to model and settings to clipboard
shared_settings_applied_notice: Display settings from the shared link have been applied. Upload your own file (.sdf, .pdb, .cif) or search for a molecule.
moving_joints_beta_banner_text: This feature is currently in testing. It generates print-in-place rotating joints directly on selected molecular bonds. We recommend verifying the clearance (c) and printing a test joint first.
joint_position_help: 0 = near atom A (stator), 1 = near atom B (rotor); automatically clamped so the joint does not intersect atom spheres
joint_skip_terminal_label: Skip terminal bonds (e.g., –H, unbranched –CH₃, –OH without H)
joint_in_rings_help: Note: a closed ring is kinematically rigid unless it has enough degrees of freedom (typically ≥ 6 bonds).
joint_enlarged_by_rod_note: Joint was enlarged to match bond rod thickness: R =
joint_stats_skipped_suffix: bonds are too short for a joint or would collide – increase model scale or reduce atom sphere size.
joint_param_R_title: Radius of the stator/rotor cylinder. If the bond rod is thicker, the joint automatically scales up to match the rod radius.
joint_param_rs_title: Narrowest part of the rotor inside the stator neck – determines torsional and bending strength.
joint_param_rs_help: Narrowest part of the rotor in the stator neck.
joint_param_rh_title: Equator of the inner rotor double-cone; must be greater than rs + c, otherwise the rotor will fall out.
joint_param_rh_help: Equator of the inner rotor double-cone (> rs + c).
joint_param_neck_title: Axial length of the cylindrical shaft section.
joint_param_neck_help: Axial length of the cylindrical shaft section.
joint_param_wall_title: Bottom thickness of the stator under the head tip and minimum wall limit at the equator.
joint_param_wall_help: Stator bottom thickness and equator wall limit.
joint_param_topLen_title: Short solid cylinder of the rotor above the parting cone.
joint_param_topLen_help: Solid rotor cylinder above the parting cone.
joint_param_radialSegments_title: Rotational mesh resolution (higher = smoother rotation, larger STL).
joint_param_radialSegments_help: Circumferential resolution of the revolved mesh.
joint_param_arcSegments_title: Fillet resolution of clearance corners inside the stator cavity.
joint_min_free_bond_prefix: Minimum free bond length between spheres: approx.
joint_svg_aria_label: Axial cross-section diagram of the print-in-place joint with dimensions R, rs, rh, c, neck, wall, topLen
joint_svg_caption: Half axial cross-section of the joint (all angled interfaces have a 45° slope with no horizontal overhangs)
joint_print_guide_supports_bold: Do not place supports inside the joints.
joint_print_guide_supports_text: All internal interfaces have a 45° slope and print self-supporting in any bond orientation. In your slicer, enable "Support on build plate only" (Touching build plate), or add a support blocker over the joints.
joint_print_guide_shells_bold: Do not merge shells in the slicer.
joint_print_guide_shells_text: When importing STL/3MF, keep parts separate, do not run Mesh Boolean Union, and avoid aggressive gap closing (keep Slice gap closing radius ≤ 0.05 mm).
joint_print_guide_fdm_text: avoid over-extruding the first layer (use elephant foot compensation); after printing, gently twist the joint to break it in.
joint_print_guide_sla_text: thoroughly flush uncured resin from the joint cavity before UV curing (IPA / ultrasonic bath) and rotate the joint several times while rinsing, otherwise residual resin will fuse the rotor and stator.
glued_spheres_settings_title: Split Spheres for Gluing Settings (Spheres SPLIT FOR GLUING)
glued_spheres_beta_banner_text: This feature is currently in testing. It splits each atom into a separate watertight (manifold) solid for multicolor 3D printing without AMS/MMU and subsequent gluing.
glued_spheres_mode_radical: Mode A – Radical Planes (default, flat cutting faces)
glued_spheres_priority_label: Element Priority Order (higher priority = full sphere)
glued_spheres_priority_help: Reorder elements using the arrows. Higher-priority atoms stay full spheres; lower-priority atoms get concave sockets subtracted.
glued_spheres_gap_help: Insets each part at the cutting face by gap/2 (default 0 mm, range 0–0.30 mm).
glued_spheres_merge_same_element_label: Merge touching atoms of the same element into one part (same color without gluing)
glued_spheres_peg_holes_label: 1.75 mm Filament Peg Holes (Mode A only)
glued_spheres_export_assembled: Assembled – separate STLs in absolute coordinates (C/C_1.stl)
glued_spheres_export_plate: On Build Plate – one STL per element (plate_C.stl), largest cut face down
glued_spheres_exploded_help: Shifts parts away from the molecule centroid to inspect cutting faces (does not affect export).
glued_spheres_show_labels_label: Show Part ID Labels in Preview (e.g. C_1, O_2)
glued_spheres_large_molecule_warning: Warning: Molecule contains more than 2000 atoms. Computing CSG solids may take a long time.
infobox_helptext: This app is designed to assist you in multicolor 3D printing of molecular structures.
infobox_appusage:
How to use this app?
  • Search for/Import your molecular data (.sdf)
  • Fetch the data
  • Download the model
infobox_slicer_multipartobject:
How to import to slicer?
Simply open the .3mf file in your slicer (Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, OrcaSlicer) – it opens directly as a colored multi-part model with colors preserved.

If using ZIP with STL files, ensure the slicer shows ‘Multi-part object detected’ and confirm with ‘YES.’

adv_draw_charge_plus: Positive charge (click an atom to add +1)
adv_draw_charge_minus: Negative charge (click an atom to add −1)

adv_draw_element_title: Element {element} (click an atom to change it, empty space to add one)
adv_pubchem_label: Compound name, formula, PubChem CID, or CAS number
adv_pubchem_hint: Searches the public PubChem database (organic and bioorganic molecules). Formulas work too, e.g. H2O, CO2, h2so4 – all matching isomers are listed.
adv_ccd_label: Ligand code (CCD) or cofactor / complex name
adv_ccd_hint: Ideal for 3D printing cofactors, drugs, and metal complexes (heme, chlorophyll, ATP, B12) from the PDB Chemical Component Dictionary.
adv_ccd_placeholder: e.g., HEM, ATP, CLA, heme, chlorophyll
adv_pdb_hint: Searches experimental 3D structures of proteins and nucleic acids in RCSB PDB.
adv_cactus_label: SMILES, InChI, or systematic IUPAC name
adv_cactus_hint: Generates 3D coordinates via the NIH CACTUS Chemical Identifier Resolver (including compounds without 3D conformers in PubChem).

adv_cod_label: Mineral / compound name, formula, or COD ID
adv_cod_hint: Searches Crystallography Open Database by fulltext, chemical formula (e.g., CaCO3, SiO2, NaCl), or loads a numeric COD ID directly.
offline_search_notice: You are offline. Searching online databases requires an internet connection. You can upload your own file (SDF, PDB, CIF) or draw a molecule (Advanced Search → Draw).
adv_conformer_hint: Instead of the default structure, lists all 3D conformers PubChem has for the compound (in diversity order, with MMFF94 energy).
adv_conformer_energy_title: MMFF94 energy from PubChem; difference to the lowest in brackets
adv_conformer_none: PubChem has no 3D conformers for this compound (typically salts, metal complexes, or very flexible molecules).
